builder: scripts/sphere_plane_table.py (MIME), its parts built on GitHub's runners (probe run 42949957251, 12 shares and the checks) and merged by its merge command
builder_version: none: a script, named by its commit and its hash below

parameters.collocation: Gauss-Legendre nodes in mu, the series' length plus an eighth (at least 16), at phi 0.7
parameters.traction: Gauss-Legendre, twice the collocation's nodes, four angles

checks.name: the solver's normal and spin against Brenner's and Jeffery's series at d 0.3, 0.03, 0.003
the coupling's reciprocity (force per rotation against torque per translation) at every knot and midpoint
the no-slip condition at nodes not collocated, every knot and midpoint
checks.tolerance: at most 1e-9 of the motion's speed

checks.name: each entry's change with the series' length and the nodes x1.25 and the traction's nodes x2, at d 1e-3 and 0.01

domain.unit: the gap over the sphere's radius

notes: the bispherical solutions: Brenner (1961) and Jeffery (1915) summed in closed form, Dean and O'Neill's (1963) and O'Neill's (1964) problems solved in their representation by collocation; scripts/sphere_plane_table.py's docstring holds the method
the predictions for these checks were committed before the build ran (tests/oracles/predictions_w2a_1b.json)
